title: Exercise: enrollment per course
description: Count the students in every course, including courses nobody took.

input.query: -- Write your query here, then press Run.

exercise.prompt: For every course, show its course_id and how many enrollments it has across all sections. Courses with no enrollments must appear with 0.
exercise.solution:
SELECT c.course_id, COUNT(e.student_id) AS enrolled
FROM courses AS c
LEFT JOIN sections AS s ON s.course_id = c.course_id
LEFT JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.section_id = s.section_id
GROUP BY c.course_id;
